name: lookup_employee
description: Find the caller in the employee directory from their employee ID and full name. Call this first on every call. match=false means the ID and name don't fit a record.

employee_id.description: Employee ID the caller gave, e.g. E1001. Spoken digits are fine.

full_name.description: The caller's full name, as they said it. Some people have a single name: use it as given.
